'''2007 Maryland State Championship Kevin Elia DS Blockade Flagship: Bridge''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Elia]] at [[2007 Maryland State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' Kevin Elig?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
